summary: Nuran Wireless filed a Form 6-K attaching a Secured Revolving Credit Agreement dated October 29, 2026, a General Security Agreement, and a news release confirming a US$10 million non-dilutive secured revolving facility for general working capital. The lender is redacted; subsidiary guarantors grant first-ranking security over all present and after-acquired property, subject to an African subsidiary carve-out. The release also confirms no ATM sales at current market levels. This is a routine credit-facility financing, not a special situation; no ownership, premium, or deal clock. Watch covenant headroom and liquidity.
